docs.title: Getting Started
docs.description: Everything a new trainer needs to connect to PokéBedrock servers.
docs.body: Install Minecraft Bedrock, add the PokéBedrock server, then claim your starter kit.

pokemon.title: Bulbasaur
pokemon.description: Grass/Poison starter available from Professor Oak.
pokemon.body: Bulbasaur excels in early gyms thanks to Sleep Powder and Leech Seed.

moves.title: Vine Whip
moves.body: Vine Whip hits for 45 base power and is learned naturally by most Grass starters.
